Subject: Intro + gap analysis request: Helios Health (AWS co-sell opportunity)

Hi Anjali / Marcus —

Quick context: Helios Health is evaluating a marketplace + co-sell path for their clinical NLP workload. We did a short POC last quarter and Helios is now asking for a formal joint-account intro with AWS to align GTM and validate a compliance gap list ahead of listing.

As a starting point, can we:
- Do a 30–45 min stakeholder intro (Helios execs + AWS partner rep + Redwood GTM/product)
- Run a short gap analysis on listing readiness (security/compliance, procurement, pricing model) so Helios can prioritize items for Q1 procurement

Proposed times (PST): Mon 11/13 10:00–10:45, Tue 11/14 09:00–09:45, Tue 11/14 15:00–15:45. Happy to adjust.

What I can bring: a one-page MAP draft, product/usage summary, and an abbreviated SOC 2 rundown. If there are specific artifacts AWS needs for the gap analysis, let me know and I’ll pull them together.

Attaching: redwood_helio_intro-deck.pdf (two-slide summary).

Thanks — looking forward.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Partner Sales

Thanks for the note — happy to join the intro.

A few items from the AWS side for prep so the gap analysis is actionable:
- Copy of SOC 2 / ISO attestation or the most recent security summary you can share (Helios — thanks for the questionnaire, that helps)
- Expected annual spend or target ARR for the listing (ballpark is fine)

I can bring the AWS partner GTM rep and a marketplace listing specialist to the meeting. If Helios can share the questionnaire before the call, we’ll surface the top 3 listing blockers and give recommended next steps.

For time, Marcus confirms Tue 11/14 09:00 EST works. See you then.
